title: Invasive Species
author: Rachel Helps and Steven L. Peck
description:
Some thirty years in the future, aliens have contacted Earth. They're willing to help humans overcome some of their genetic pitfalls, like not being able to see UV light or hating exercise. The partnering human company claims that the genetic modification procedure is free, but there is a cost...

Deal with your ambitious daughter, take care of your disabled grandson, and decide how loyal to be to Uplift, Inc. Optional text explains the consequences of most choices. Co-authored with Steve L. Peck, the acclaimed author of A Short Stay in Hell.

Content warning: Body horror; body dysphoria; discussion of disability, race, and colorism.
